deviations.what: The first_listed_only parameter (line 8) is never used; the filter on lines 11-12 keeps every CPC code and never restricts to cpc_seq == 0, so the default TRUE setting counts all codes instead of the first-listed one.

notes: Dating by filing_year, the missing-class filter, the base window (class filed in fy counts for focal years fy+1 to fy+5), the forward window (fy-1 to fy-3), the anti-join for new classes, the empty-base NA rule, the no-forward zero rule, firm separation, and output collapse and columns all match the spec. Only the first-listed-only rule deviates.
